Tom Ryan ( Ennis & Abby Pastoral Area) Reflection. In the evening of our lives we will be examined on love. Saint Mother Teresa said: “The biggest disease in the world today is the feeling of being unwanted. And the greatest evil in the world is the terrible indifference towards one’s neighbour.” Lord, open our hearts when they are closed, and warm them when they are cold, so that we may produce the fruits of love and be found worthy of belonging to your Kilkee (Kilfearagh)
